name: @siftable/cli
description: Siftable CLI — human planning tasks, executable agent work queues, knowledge, and automation tools

scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace @siftable/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @siftable/tabular-import && npm run build --workspace @siftable/taster
scripts.build: node scripts/clean-dist.mjs && tsc && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.mkdirSync('dist/lib/vendor',{recursive:true});for(const name of ['datasetQueryContract','leadDiscovery','leadDiscoveryCommandContract','agentWorkSecrets'])fs.copyFileSync('../shared/dist/types/'+name+'.js','dist/lib/vendor/'+name+'.js')" && npm run build:taster-vendor
scripts.build:taster-vendor: tsc -p src/lib/review/tsconfig.vendor.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const v='dist/lib/vendor/taster';fs.cpSync('../taster/policy/default',v+'/policy/default',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync(v+'/trusted/scripts/ci',{recursive:true});for(const name of ['ratchetGrowth.mjs','ratchetGrowthRead.mjs'])fs.copyFileSync('../../scripts/ci/'+name,v+'/trusted/scripts/ci/'+name)"
scripts.interactive:dev: npm run manifest && (cd interactive-tui && bun run native:build) && SIFT_INTERACTIVE_RUNTIME=source node ./bin/run.js interactive
scripts.interactive:help: npm run build && npm run manifest && node ./bin/run.js interactive --help
scripts.package:interactive: npm run build --workspace @siftable/cli && bun install --cwd interactive-tui --frozen-lockfile && npm run native:release --workspace @siftable/cli && bun run interactive-tui/scripts/build-packaged-runtime.mjs
scripts.test:harness: cd interactive-tui && bun run pretest && bun test test/agentHarnessBoundary.test.ts test/agentHarnessWorkTools.test.ts test/compaction.test.ts test/modelLimits.test.ts test/toolAuthorization.test.ts test/toolRegistration.test.ts test/steering.test.ts test/commandPolicy.test.ts test/packagedRuntime.test.ts test/headless.test.ts test/sessionServer.test.ts test/sessionMode.test.ts test/providerTransport.test.ts test/providerJournal.test.ts test/providerReceiptSchema.test.ts test/requestInspection.test.ts test/candidateVerification.test.ts test/completionVerification.test.ts test/verification.integration.test.ts test/sessionOutput.test.ts test/toolResultProjection.test.ts test/searchToolResult.test.ts test/repetition.test.ts test/settlement.test.ts test/requestBudget.test.ts && bun test test/agent-persistence.test.ts && bun test test/compact.test.ts && bun test test/rollout.test.ts
scripts.test:tui: cd interactive-tui && bun run pretest && bun test
scripts.test-coverage: npm run test:jest -- --coverage && npm run test:vitest -- --coverage.enabled
scripts.verify:harness: npm run typecheck:tui && vitest run test/commands/interactive.chat-agent.test.ts --config vitest.config.ts && npm run test:harness
scripts.verify:package: npm run package:interactive && npm run verify:harness && node scripts/verify-package-imports.mjs && npm run test:packaged
scripts.prepack: npm run manifest && npm run verify:package
